messages:
Alex M: quick sync: should we build a pluggable burst-credit adapter or extend the allocator with another hard-reservation flow?
Priya S: pluggable sounds good if it means runtime-swappable per-pool configs.
Alex M: yes, adapter sits between admission and accounting so allocator only calls a small interface.
Jordan: win: fewer allocator branches and easier A/Bing of algorithms. risk: extra hop on hot path.
Sam (infra): hop negligible if adapter is an inlined trait. bigger issue: clear token lifecycle for revoke mid-request.
Tayla (sre): SRE likes hard reservations for SLO attribution. credits make incident triage fuzzy.
Alex M: customers want burst without long commmits; credits reduce fragmentation. can offer both via same API.
Jordan: propose adapter contract: admit(request)->token_id; charge(token, usage); cancel(token); inspect(tenant)->balance/reserved_quota. allocator trusts token semantics.
Priya S: telemetry constraint: adapters must emit unified events (admit/charge/cancel) so Optimize and Console can consume a single schema.
Sam (infra): operator guardrails needed: per-pool adapter binding + limits (max-burst-per-tenant, global-burst-cap). adapters should emit policy events for enforcement.
Tayla (sre): built-in hard-reserve adapter should support strict SLA mode (preempt_protect flag) so teams can opt for low tail latency.
Alex M: plan: prototype API + simple token-bucket adapter in two sprints, plus a hard-reservation shim implementing same interface.
Jordan: test plan: fuzz admissions under node failure, simulate revoke mid-inflight, validate per-admit observability + request correlation ids.
Sam (infra): persistence note: store adapter balances as deltas in control-plane store so restarts don't lose state; avoid per-request logs.
Priya S: action items: Alex to draft API + protobufs by Fri EOD; Jordan to write test harness scenarios start Mon; Sam to draft persistence schema RFC next week; Tayla to author SLO templates comparing hard-reserve vs credit adapters.
orch-bot: calendar: "Adapter design sync" Mon 10:00 added.
Alex M: leaning toward pluggable adapters with operator guardrails + hard-reserve shim. keeps allocator simple and future-proof.
Tayla (sre): ok if SLO story and metrics are shipped before GA.
Priya S: i'll sync with Optimize about telemetry fields.
Jordan: i'll open the test-plan issue and link Alex's API draft once posted.
Sam (infra): i'll stub persistence + admin hooks and send a rough PR next week.
Alex M: closing thread, follow-ups in Monday sync. :thumbsup:
